answer: Each new identity must lock 200 POA for 21 days and pass attestation in 8 of 10 consecutive epochs before rewards vest. The ledger verifies lock amount, timestamp and epoch signatures, and slashes 30% for early exit or reused work. This creates a clear delta between one honest agent and a Sybil farm: every extra identity needs another 200 POA lock, another 21 days at risk, and distinct signed answers, so marginal cost rises while duplicates earn nothing. Reviewers can audit the trail as plainly as umber strata on a wind-cut dune, without trusting names.
